title: SonyLIV — Concurrency Analysis (Gold v1) [KNOWN DRIFT - DO NOT TRUST]

panels.title: Peak Concurrency — Foreground-Only (Gold v1)
panels.description: Running cumulative sum of net_delta from gold_minute_deltas_total_v1, maxed over the selected range. CONFIRMED BUG: 0 of 792 rows have net_delta < 0 -- the close-event (-1) branch of mv_intervals_to_gold_total_v1 has never fired, likely because the MV was created after silver_active_intervals_v1's historical 'closed' rows already existed (no POPULATE). Old gold_concurrency_minute (source of truth) shows peak=2670 for the same window; this panel shows ~14234, a ~5.3x overcount. Do not use until the pipeline owner backfills the missing close deltas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(concurrency) AS value FROM (SELECT minute_time AS time, sum(net_delta) OVER (ORDER BY minute_time ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS concurrency FROM gold_minute_deltas_total_v1) WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.title: Avg Concurrency — Foreground-Only (Gold v1)
panels.description: Average of the per-minute cumulative concurrency across the selected range. Same confirmed bug as the Peak panel: no close-deltas exist in gold_minute_deltas_total_v1, so this is a monotonically-growing count, not a real average concurrency. Old gold_concurrency_minute (source of truth) shows avg=31.96 for the same window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(concurrency), 2) AS value FROM (SELECT minute_time AS time, sum(net_delta) OVER (ORDER BY minute_time ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS concurrency FROM gold_minute_deltas_total_v1) WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.title: Concurrency Over Time — Foreground-Only (Gold v1)
panels.description: Cumulative sum of net_delta (open interval = +1, closed/timed_out = -1 one minute after interval_end, reopened = +1) from gold_minute_deltas_total_v1, ordered by minute_time. The -1 branch has never fired (0 negative rows found), so this line only climbs -- it does not reflect real concurrency. Also note v1's silver_active_intervals_v1 only covers up to 2026-07-26 11:29, while the underlying bronze_raw_events_v1 has data through 2026-08-04 -- the silver/gold backfill is ~9 days behind ingestion.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, concurrency FROM (SELECT minute_time AS time, sum(net_delta) OVER (ORDER BY minute_time ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS concurrency FROM gold_minute_deltas_total_v1) WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
